operator_visible_outcome: Freeze the reviewed Product and Assurance structure against exact source, proof and artefact identities

inputs.validation: Canonical bounded snapshots, comparisons, sign-off report and artefacts from exact commits

outputs.validation: Canonical freeze record whose complete evidence graph regenerates from the named repositories

canonical_state: Before and after Product and Assurance structure snapshots
Statement, decision, mutation, suppression and architecture-exception comparisons
Cohesive ownership decisions for every reviewed file split
Exact-pair sign-off report and reported Product artefacts
derived_state: Trusted-root verification result for the complete freeze graph

authorities.grant: Accept only the exact reviewed CEL-SPLIT-008 declaration bytes
authorities.refusal: Reject a missing, additional or changed CEL-SPLIT-008 declaration

authorities.grant: Verify the freeze against exact repositories, source records, sign-off and artefacts
authorities.refusal: Reject missing, substituted, contradictory, non-canonical or unbound evidence

trust_boundaries.treatment: Compare the declaration bytes with the exact reviewed digest
Read bounded canonical records, regenerate inventories and bind all comparisons to exact source identities

resources.acquisition: Run bounded Git and Go inspection commands against exact commits
resources.bound: At most four processes and 1800000 milliseconds
resources.release: Join every inspection command before returning
resources.cleanup_failure: Return a verification error without accepting the freeze
resources.cancellation: Cancel owned commands when the verification context ends
resources.join: Observe every owned command exit before returning

resources.acquisition: Create bounded evidence outputs beneath an operator-selected absolute root
resources.release: Publish each complete canonical record atomically
resources.cleanup_failure: Leave no accepted freeze and report the failed publication
resources.recovery: Regenerate unpublished records from the unchanged exact commits

platforms.evidence: Native exact-pair structure verification and sign-off

invariants.statement: Every accepted structural claim is bound to exact Product and Assurance source identities
invariants.boundary: retained evidence to immutable repository commits
invariants.falsifier: A substituted source, report, observation, comparison record or executable identity is accepted

assurance_controls.owner: trusted-root structure verification and source-binding mutations

invariants.residual_uncertainty: The freeze proves the recorded structure and evidence graph, not future code correctness

invariants.statement: Every remaining threshold file has one cohesive owner and a concrete renewed-review trigger
invariants.falsifier: A governed file at or above the threshold is absent, arbitrarily split or justified without an owner and trigger
invariants.residual_uncertainty: Cohesion is a reviewed engineering judgement constrained by the recorded inventory

invariants.statement: The accepted freeze uses a passing exact-pair sign-off and the exact reported artefact bytes
invariants.boundary: sign-off report and artefacts to freeze acceptance
invariants.falsifier: A failed, unsigned, mismatched or altered report or artefact is accepted

assurance_controls.owner: sign-off identity and artefact hash verification

invariants.residual_uncertainty: An authorised same-user rewrite of the evidence root remains outside the proof

success_semantics: Accepted means every snapshot, comparison, threshold reason, sign-off identity and artefact hash verifies against the exact named pair
refusal_semantics: Missing, additional, stale, substituted, contradictory, oversized or non-canonical evidence is rejected
failure_semantics: Unavailable required tooling, source materialisation failure or evidence read failure cannot produce acceptance
cancellation_semantics: Cancellation joins owned inspection commands and cannot produce acceptance
indeterminate_semantics: Incomplete or contradictory evidence remains explicitly unaccepted
recovery_semantics: Regenerate unpublished records from unchanged exact commits then verify the complete graph again
compatibility_or_reset_policy: This unused pre-release freeze format has no compatibility obligation and may be reset coherently
falsifiers: A changed repository, report, observation, comparison record or executable retains acceptance
A threshold file lacks a cohesive owner or renewed-review trigger
A failed sign-off or altered Product artefact is accepted
An unbound comparison digest is accepted as semantic evidence

assurance_controls.owner: trusted-root structure verification and source-binding mutations
sign-off identity and artefact hash verification

residual_limitations: The freeze records structure and evidence identity; it does not prove all runtime semantics
Native exact-pair sign-off remains qualified only on Windows AMD64
The evidence root is trusted against authorised same-user replacement
non_goals: Change Product runtime, protocol, persistence or containment behaviour
Create compatibility aliases, wrappers, registries or general architecture machinery
Treat file count or test count as evidence of correctness
Accept a freeze before exact-pair sign-off and trusted-root verification pass
deletion_criteria: Delete this declaration only when a later reviewed structure contract explicitly supersedes every recorded invariant
